<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="20" y="19" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="17" x2="326" y2="13" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="17" x2="331" y2="11" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="17" x2="336" y2="8" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="341" y1="17" x2="341" y2="5" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="355" cy="13" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="352" y1="13" x2="348" y2="9" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="358" y1="13" x2="362" y2="9" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="370" y="7" width="18" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="372" y="9" width="13" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#15451F"/>
    <line x1="389" y1="11" x2="389" y2="14" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Onboarding header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="58" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="31,57 23,57 30,50" fill="none" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="24" y1="57" x2="39" y2="57" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="64" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Set up your learning</text>
    <circle cx="352" cy="57" r="14" fill="#F8FCFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="347" y1="52" x2="357" y2="62" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="357" y1="52" x2="347" y2="62" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Progress -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="98" width="342" height="12" rx="64" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <rect x="24" y="98" width="114" height="12" rx="64" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <text x="24" y="130" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">STEP 1 OF 3</text>
    <text x="366" y="130" text-anchor="end" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#00A47D">33%</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Travel illustration panel -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="153" width="346" height="184" rx="14" fill="#C9C7C7" opacity="0.25"/>
    <rect x="20" y="151" width="346" height="184" rx="14" fill="#D1EBF7"/>
    <circle cx="307" cy="191" r="25" fill="#FFC800"/>
    <polygon points="20,290 95,225 145,267 211,205 366,313 366,335 20,335" fill="#9DAD88"/>
    <polygon points="20,305 104,257 161,295 232,246 366,324 366,335 20,335" fill="#456B64"/>
    <line x1="58" y1="278" x2="58" y2="210" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <polygon points="58,207 88,218 58,229" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <rect x="46" y="278" width="24" height="28" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polygon points="46,278 58,267 70,278" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <circle cx="278" cy="271" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="299" cy="271" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="275" y="269" width="28" height="15" rx="4" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <polygon points="271,270 284,257 306,270" fill="#15451F"/>
    <line x1="286" y1="257" x2="286" y2="246" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="286,246 299,250 286,254" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="185" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
    <circle cx="72" cy="174" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
    <circle cx="91" cy="190" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
    <rect x="281" y="300" width="43" height="9" rx="4" fill="#FFC800"/>
    <polygon points="324,300 336,304 324,309" fill="#FFC800"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Intro copy -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Learn for your next trip</text>
    <text x="195" y="412" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#4B4B4C">Tell us where you’re going and we’ll</text>
    <text x="195" y="435" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#4B4B4C">help you practice the words you’ll use.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Destination field -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="481" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Where are you traveling?</text>
    <rect x="22" y="494" width="346" height="58" rx="13" fill="#C9C7C7" opacity="0.22"/>
    <rect x="20" y="492" width="346" height="58" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="521" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="55" y1="528" x2="62" y2="535" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="76" y="528" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#4B4B4C">Barcelona, Spain</text>
    <circle cx="341" cy="521" r="10" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <polyline points="336,521 340,525 347,517" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="24" y="574" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">You can change this later in your preferences.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Trip detail cards -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="615" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Make it personal</text>
    <rect x="20" y="629" width="166" height="66" rx="14" fill="#C9C7C7" opacity="0.22"/>
    <rect x="18" y="627" width="166" height="66" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="660" r="16" fill="#FFEF8F"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="656" r="6" fill="#15451F"/>
    <ellipse cx="48" cy="670" rx="11" ry="6" fill="#15451F"/>
    <text x="75" y="656" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Trip length</text>
    <text x="75" y="678" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">7 days</text>
    <rect x="204" y="627" width="166" height="66" rx="14" fill="#C9C7C7" opacity="0.22"/>
    <rect x="202" y="625" width="166" height="66" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="232" cy="658" r="16" fill="#DDF4FF"/>
    <polygon points="232,646 236,655 246,656 238,663 240,673 232,668 224,673 226,663 218,656 228,655" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <text x="259" y="654" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Focus</text>
    <text x="259" y="676" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Getting around</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Continue button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="715" width="346" height="50" rx="13" fill="#15451F" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="20" y="713" width="346" height="50" rx="13" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <text x="195" y="745" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">CONTINUE</text>
    <polyline points="333,738 339,744 333,750" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="782" width="390" height="62" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="782" x2="390" y2="782" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Home -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="39,802 51,793 63,802" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="43" y="801" width="16" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="51" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">HOME</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Practice -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="146" cy="803" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="146" y1="796" x2="146" y2="810" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="139" y1="803" x2="153" y2="803" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="146" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">PRACTICE</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="244" cy="798" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="244" cy="812" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="244" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">PROFILE</text>
    </g>
    <!-- More -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="337" cy="799" r="2.5" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <circle cx="337" cy="806" r="2.5" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <circle cx="337" cy="813" r="2.5" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <text x="337" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">MORE</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
